traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for Story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied. The ESLint plugin is implemented in TypeScript, exports a standards-compliant plugin object (rules, configs, meta, maintenance), dynamically loads multiple rules, and exposes flat-config presets compatible with ESLint v9. Robust error handling is implemented for rule and metadata loading, with corresponding tests confirming graceful behavior. The plugin is structured as a publishable npm package with appropriate package.json metadata. User-facing and developer documentation files referenced by the story all exist. All tests tied directly to this story and its requirements pass in the latest Jest run, confirming correct behavior and integration.
